item.title: 30 inch pothole, 10th September
item.description:
Further to my report earlier. Now with photographs. I revise what I said in my previous report. This pothole is 30 inches across. In the photographs you can see the respira that have been effected and you can see the hole that has been left unrepaired, spilling hardcore onto the street. As you can see, it’s literally next to the G in the painted No Parking sign which was painted to clear the road for a repair. The sign is dated 26 August, but your people came only today - 10 September. Now they have removed the cones, packed up and left. Job left unfinished. I have reported these potholes politely, respectfully, persistently. Now I’ve had enough of you dreadful people. Come back and finish the job.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 8b, Highview Road, Albany Park, Sidcup, Greater London
